ja269:1.3: Those with rough voices are not dear,
ja269:1.4: in this world or the next.
ja269:2.1: Surely you must see this one,
ja269:2.2: who is black, ugly, mottled with spots,
ja269:2.3: The cuckoo, because of his soft voice,
ja269:3.1: Therefore for the one of kind voice,
ja269:3.2: a wise speaker, and not haughty,
ja269:3.3: Who explains both the Dhamma and its meaning,
